newsitem.title: CANADA: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange holiday hours.
newsitem.headline: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange holiday hours.

text.p: The Winnipeg Commodity Exchange will close early on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.
Trade at the exchange will end at 1220 CST/1820 GMT on Dec 24 and Dec 31 instead of the usual 1320 CST/1920 GMT, the WCE said.
The WCE will be closed December 25 and 26 in observance of the Christmas and Boxing Day holidays, as well as on New Years Day, January 1.
